content: Supabase Edge Functions are publicly invocable HTTP endpoints by default -- the function body itself is the trust boundary, not network-level access control. Always verify the caller's JWT inside the function before doing privileged work; do not rely on 'verify_jwt' project setting alone for authorization (it only checks the token is valid, not what the caller is allowed to do). For createUser/inviteUserByEmail: extract caller identity, look up caller role in profiles, reject with 403 if not owner/reception (or not owner when target role='dueño'), only then call the admin client.
